homeFaq.title: Frequently asked questions
homeFaq.subtitle: Short answers about budgets, timelines and what performance partnership looks like.

items.q: What budgets do you work with?
items.a: We optimize around unit economics first — disciplined tests matter more than a flashy starting budget. On a strategy call we’ll align an acceptable range for your niche and goals.

items.q: How fast can we see results?
items.a: Early directional signals often appear within 2–4 weeks after launch with reliable tracking. Stable conclusions usually need a few creative/bundle iterations and enough volume.

items.q: Do you handle strategy and execution end‑to‑end?
items.a: Yes — we can own strategy → production → media → analytics. If you have an in‑house team, we integrate and plug gaps surgically.
We align on KPIs (leads, CPL, ROAS, revenue — whatever fits your model) and run recurring reviews with actionable conclusions — not spreadsheet theater.
Yes — multi‑geo launches and scaling, localized landings and consistent attribution for comparable metrics across regions.

items.q: What do you need from us to start?
items.a: Access to ad accounts and analytics (or a plan to wire them), clarity on offer and target economics — we help secure the rest during onboarding.

items.q: How are you different from a typical agency?
items.a: We obsess over ROI and iteration velocity — premium UX, transparent hypotheses and accountability across ads → site → revenue, not vanity reporting.
